description: Elections Commission - Enforcing the Gaz. Notification on Direction for a Further Period of Three Months
reasoning: This gazette notification specifically deals with extending the validity period of directions issued for the Local Authorities Election - 2023. It references previous gazette notifications related to election directions and extends their enforcement for a further three months. This content falls squarely under electoral processes and election-related administrative matters, making it a Type 7 (Elections) classification.
